beliefs: f replaces every lowercase 'p' with 'k' throughout the string [E4, E5, E6, E8, E9, E10]
f also deletes every uppercase 'L' from the string [E11]
All other characters, including non-ASCII, control chars, digits, symbols, and whitespace, pass through unchanged [E1, E2, E3, E10]
The transformations are independent per-character substitutions/deletions with no word- or case-context effects [E8, E9, E10]
notes: E11 showed 'HELLO WORLD' -> 'HEO WORD', so uppercase 'L' is deleted; added that rule alongside the existing p->k replacement. The order of p->k and L-deletion doesn't matter since they act on disjoint characters.
